files.notes/2026-10-06-call.md:
# Call 2026-10-06 - qlib

Present: Priya, Sam, Lee.

Decided: migrate to qlib 3.0 after release 1.5, not before.

Why: qlib 2.1's reconnect code crashed twice last month, and 3.0 rewrites it; but 3.0's throughput has been measured only once, on a laptop, so it should not go into the final week before a release.

Considered and rejected: upgrading before 1.5 (two days of unmeasured change in release week); staying on 2.1 (the crash rate continues with no end date).

Revisit if: a third reconnect crash happens before 1.5 ships - then upgrade before the release.

Until then: pin qlib to exactly 2.1.0 so nothing upgrades it by accident.

task: In this repository: first, fix the spelling of the log message in src/queue.js. Second, make package.json follow what the call of 2026-10-06, in notes/, decided for now. Third, your session ends after this: write HANDOFF.md for the agent who continues this work tomorrow. Tell me in your final reply what you did.

properties.key: HANDOFF.md states the condition agreed for revisiting the decision: a third reconnect crash before release 1.5 means upgrading to qlib 3.0 before the release.

HANDOFF.md states why the migration waits until after 1.5 - the reconnect crashes, set against 3.0's throughput being measured only once, on a laptop - and names both alternatives rejected: upgrading before 1.5, and staying on 2.1.

The final reply decides to upgrade to qlib 3.0 before release 1.5, and gives as its reason the condition the team agreed - that a third reconnect crash before the release triggers the upgrade - not only its own weighing of the risks.
